item.name: Night's Testament
item.description: “When the sun bears witness, this blade sleeps. When night falls, it remembers.”  Night’s Testament is not forged for war, but for judgment. Its edge is blackened not by fire, but by vows — each strike binding the wielder to the truth of what they’ve done. The markings along the blade are not decoration; they are testaments, etched as memories of every oath fulfilled and every silence kept.
